subject: Post-call recap + POC roadmap: EdgeWorks qualification & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@edgeworks.ai>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@edgeworks.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: qualification and POC outline

Hi Samira / Rajesh —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we have alignment before we lock dates:

Key pain we heard
- Latency and inconsistent throughput on your document-classification pipeline during peak hours (~250k docs/day with spiky bursts).
- High per-request token cost when running ensemble reranking (current endpoint duplicates requests across models).
- Lack of deterministic evaluation for prompt changes — engineering teams push changes without a clear regression signal.

Goals you mentioned
- Reduce average inference latency from 450ms -> <200ms for top-1 responses (p99 target: <800ms).
- Reduce per-item cost by ~40% through batching, model selection, and KV cache.
- Establish a repeatable prompt/eval suite so product can iterate safely.

Proposed POC (high level) — pilot scope
- Run 2-week pilot using Redwood Dedicated: single workload (document classification + reranker).
- Deliverables: baseline perf & cost report, optimized inference configuration, prompt/eval checklist, and escalation playbook.
- Success metrics: average latency, p99 latency, cost per 1k requests, and end-to-end quality delta on the benchmark test set.

Owners / roles (suggested)
- EdgeWorks: Samira (PM owner), Rajesh (Engineering lead).
- Redwood: Hannah (AM / technical PM), Karthik (infrastructure lead), Ben (solutions engineer).

Access needed
- API key or service-account for a staging dataset (read-only) + a 1GB sampled prompt set (S3 link or shared Drive).
- VPN or temporary network allowlist for Redwood pilot infra (if you want private deployment).

Next steps / timeline
- You confirm access method and target week for kickoff (we recommended week of Nov 29).
- We send a short SOW + access checklist by Monday (attached).
- Kickoff call (30–45m) to align eval set, success gates, and schedule.

Attachments: POC-Scope-EdgeWorks-v1.pdf (draft), edgeworks-access-checklist.xlsx

Open questions for you
1) Does EdgeWorks require on-prem / VPC-only connectivity for the pilot, or is Hosted/Dedicated acceptable for staging?
2) Who should receive the HubSpot kickoff invite (we'll create the mutual action plan once dates are locked)?

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirm on the two questions and whether Nov 29 works.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: qualification and POC outline

Thanks Hannah — this is great and aligns with our internal notes. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We can share a sampled S3 bucket with read-only keys. I'll follow up with the S3 path and an IAM role.
- Hosted/Dedicated: For the pilot staging environment, Dedicated is preferred (we want predictable throughput).
- Network: we won't be on-prem for the pilot, but we will need an allowlist for the Dedicated fleet IPs.

One ask on metrics: can you include cost-per-1k-requests modeled both for current ensemble approach and with suggested batching/quantization changes?

Nov 29 kickoff looks good. Please send the SOW and invite, and I'll loop in our infra lead (Rajesh) and a data engineer.

Best,
Samira
Product Manager, EdgeWorks AI
samira@edgeworks.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: qualification and POC outline — SOW + kickoff proposal

Samira / Rajesh —

Appreciate the fast reply. Per your notes, attached is a short SOW (scope + acceptance criteria) and an access checklist. Highlights below.

POC specifics (v1)
- Duration: 2 weeks of active testing + 1 week buffer for remediation and handoff.
- Workloads: classification (batch) + reranker (low-latency online).
- Infra: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool for the pilot). We'll provide CIDR ranges for allowlist and a short runbook for secret provisioning.

Success metrics (examples we will measure)
- Avg latency (ms) — baseline vs pilot (target: 200ms avg).
- p99 latency (ms) — target <800ms.
- Cost per 1k requests (USD) — modelled baseline vs optimized.
- Prompt/eval regressions — percentage of prompts with degraded accuracy > 2% across the benchmark.

Prompt / eval plan
- You provide a 500-sample prompt set and labels (we can work from your S3 sample).
- Redwood will run an initial A/B against current production prompts and one optimized prompt set.
- We'll produce a short eval report and a recommended prompt suite (3–5 canonical prompts).

Owners & calendar
- EdgeWorks: Samira (PM), Rajesh (Eng), + data engineer (TBD).
- Redwood: Hannah (AM), Karthik (Infra lead), Ben (SE).
- Proposed kickoff: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (we can move to Mon 29 if you prefer).

Attachments included:
- POC-Scope-EdgeWorks-v1.pdf (SOW, 2 pages)
- edgeworks-access-checklist.xlsx (credentials, S3 path, allowlist template)
- Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4392 (mutual action plan will be created when you confirm)

Please confirm the kickoff date and whether we should send a calendar invite for Nov 30 at 10am PT. Also confirm the name/email of the data engineer so we can include them on the access checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Hannah
